verdict.rationale: Adyen explicitly documents a dedicated test environment with test credentials for full integration testing before going live, and its MCP server supports an explicit `--env=TEST` mode (vs `--env=LIVE`) so AI-native/agentic workflows can be pointed at sandbox rather than production. This directly satisfies the story for both traditional and agent-driven integration paths. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the sandbox fully mirrors production behavior, and no detail on data isolation guarantees beyond the docs' own claims.
